Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds mentioned in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by the document ChEMBL ID. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure only molecules with available canonical SMILES are returned. Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
